name: uiconfig-monorepo
description: uiconfig.js and its renderers (Tweakpane, Blueprint, React, shadcn/ui) in one repository.

scripts.build: npm run build -w uiconfig.js && npm run build -w uiconfig-react -w uiconfig-tweakpane -w uiconfig-blueprint -w uiconfig-shadcn
scripts.pages: npm run build -w uiconfig.js && npm run build -w uiconfig-tweakpane -w uiconfig-blueprint && npm run build -w uiconfig-website && npm run docs -w uiconfig-website && npm run assemble -w uiconfig-website

author: repalash <palash@shaders.app>
